Daan-daang residente ang apektado ng sunog na sumiklab sa Brgy. 127 sa Pasay City kagabi.

Ayon sa barangay, pansamantalang manunuluyan sa covered court ng isang paaralan ang mga residente habang patuloy pa ang isinasagawang imbestigasyon sa pinagmulan ng apoy. | via Jhomer Apresto/GMA Integrated News

data.english_translation: Hundreds of residents are affected by the fire that broke out in Brgy. 127 in Passay City last night. According to the rail, residents will be temporarily staying in a school’s bowled court while further investigations into the fire’s source are underway Jhomer Apresto/GMA Integrate News

Traffic Advisory: The Police are advising the motoring public that the Bog Walk Gorge in St. Catherine has become impassable due to boulders falling from the hills and rising waters level.
 
The police are urging motorists to use alternative routes where possible.
 
Updates will follow.

The National Works Agency (NWA) has announced the closure of the Bog Walk Gorge to vehicular traffic due to rising water levels in the Rio Cobre.

Motorists are advised to use the North/South Highway as an alternative route.
